snippet.title: Camping Keeper — Official Trailer | Campground Management Sim
snippet.description:
Wishlist Camping Keeper on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4920900/Camping_Keeper/

Build. Manage. Prosper. Camping Keeper is a campground management sim where every camper lives their own life: they check in, settle down, complain about dirty restrooms — then leave a review that makes or breaks your reputation. Lay out tent sites and cabins, run the water and power lines, hire staff, set your prices, and climb from a muddy one-star field to a five-star resort.
